reason_summary: Low rather than very_low. Shanan (2023) is a single unreplicated quasi-experiment, which is verbatim the protocol's own definition of Low, and the SERIOUS confounding rating does not push it out the bottom of that tier because the tier's stated floor already admits panel designs with no clear identification at all. Very low is reserved for evidence that is correlational only, speculative in mechanism, or inconsistent in pattern; a 1.37m-child, 336k-woman staggered state/cohort design with neighboring-border pairs, placebo exposure, alternative staggered-treatment estimators, mortality checks, and a measured first stage on the correct generation (child employment -0.029 SE 0.008, attendance +0.042 SE 0.008) is none of the three, and with one estimate there is no pattern that can be inconsistent. ROBINS-I SERIOUS is also not CRITICAL: the framework reserves CRITICAL for studies too problematic to enter a synthesis, so a SERIOUS study remains usable evidence, weakened. The SERIOUS rating did not change the label but it consumes any headroom inside it, for two reasons the original panel could not weigh. First, the confounder is not generic: Greenwood and Seshadri (2004), a theory paper in this same corpus, argue that skill-biased technological progress drove both the withdrawal of children from work and the fertility decline, with effective regulation arriving after the movement had begun, which is precisely the adoption endogeneity the SERIOUS rating names. Second, the hypothesis's middle link, the fall in what a child was worth to its parents, is never measured and is inferred from the two links on either side of it, while policy bundling and the child-quality channel supply a rival account predicting the same first and third links; the joint specification (any restriction -0.0050 SE 0.0013, exit age -0.0018 SE 0.0004) comes closest to separating them and does not separate them. Theory gives no prior to lean on either, since Baland and Robinson (2000) prove the sign ambiguous and Takakura (2023) gets opposite signs across household types. I did not weigh the six own-schooling studies or their nulls, which test arrow (2) and belong to the tempo chapter. Demographic significance partial, on a share of 8% computed as 0.48 * 0.85 / 5: below the protocol's 10% bar, measured on an annual birth probability at a single age rather than the TFR change 4.2 names, from one country, with no bootstrap CI as 4.2 requires. Escalate to the PI on three grounds that are protocol readings rather than evidence weighings: whether the Low tier absorbs a SERIOUS ROBINS-I rating or whether standard GRADE downgrading should apply on top of a table that already prices design into the tier; whether an unmeasured middle link with a live observationally equivalent rival counts as 'mechanism speculative' under the very_low row; and whether a point estimate below the 10% threshold whose only interval, 6.1% to 10.2%, crosses it and is itself understated by holding two of three inputs fixed reads as partial or as not significant, a threshold-policy call the chapter's own note to co-authors already flags as unresolved.
